sentences.text: Gourhari Dinda vs Unknown on 11 September, 2024

Sr. No. 54  Ct. No. 6.
 AB  (Allowed)
 C.R.M. (DB) 2603 of 2024  In Re: An Application for Bail under Section 439 of the  Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973/Under Section 483 of  the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in  connection with Panskura GRPS Case No.07 of 2022  Dated 28.9.2022 under Section 498A/302/201/34 of the  Indian Penal Code
In the matter of : Gourhari Dinda  ....Petiti  Mr. Swapan Kr. Mallick .....For the Petitione  Mr. Partha Pratim Das  Mr. Dipankar Mahata .....For the State.

1.
Heard learned Advocates for the parties.
2. Petitioner is the father in law of the victim lady.
Other in- laws have been enlarged on bail.
He stands on the same footing.
3. Hence, we are inclined to extend similar benefit to the petitioner.

4. Accordingly, the petitioner, namely, Gourhari Dinda shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Purba Medinipur, subject to condition that he shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever or commit similar offences in future.

Signed By :
APURBA BANDYOPADHYAY High Court of Calcutta 13 th of September 2024 11:22:06 AM 5.

In the event petitioner fails to appear before the trial court without any justifiable cause, the trial court shall be at liberty to cancel his bail in accordance with law without further reference to this Court.
